secrets.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
secrets.description: Discord bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot → Reset Token). Required for the bot to connect to Discord.

secrets.name: TWITCH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Twitch API client ID from the Twitch Developer Console. Used by socialMonitor.js to check live streams.

secrets.name: TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Twitch API client secret from the Twitch Developer Console. Used by socialMonitor.js to check live streams.
